seo.title: seoNationTitle
seo.minimum_data: A nation with more players than the Players page shows of it: mart_player_index.has_nation_page.
seo.page_count_driver: count(distinct nation_slug where has_nation_page) x count(locales)
seo.url_permanence_note: The slug is the country's key in dim_country, assigned once and fixed; it is letters and hyphens only, so it never takes a player page's {name}-{id} slug, and the route refuses one that would.
